promotion_requires: stable delivery identity across host/main boundary
main-process claim and effect receipt protocol
duplicate replay proof under ambiguous visible effect

conclusion: KEEP_AS_CANDIDATE. The native ledger/outbox remain authority. The candidate may prove missing effect-state semantics in CI, but must not become an 11th live managed patch until the end-to-end main-server receipt/reconciliation chain is closed.
